name: Swimming in Two Rivers
source:
Why is taking the third option sometimes the best option when it comes to choosing the right girl? Read as a rich kid tries to get out of a typical love triangle rut.

[From the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20140909225842/http://teacup.lunaen.com/index.php?topic=276.0]Teacup Lunaen[/url]]
translation:
在选择心仪女孩时，为什么第三个选项有时反而是最佳答案？看一名富家子弟如何设法摆脱老套的三角恋困局。

[译自 [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20140909225842/http://teacup.lunaen.com/index.php?topic=276.0]Teacup Lunaen[/url]]
